source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 23 May 1964, p. 1 ("No nominees: rural seats")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the rural seats report read in the Mid-Ulster Mail of 23 May 1964.

note: Triennial election of Cookstown Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There were no contests for the sixteen seats. No nominations were received for Killeenan, Slatequarry and Beaghmore. Killeenan and Beaghmore 'will again be represented by Mr. Bernard Conway and Mr. Peter Conway, respectively'; Slatequarry became a casual vacancy because the retiring member, Mr. Peter Corr, did not submit his nomination paper or the subsequent form (Mid-Ulster Mail, 6 June 1964, p. 14), so it is not recorded. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
